sre-bot: alert: p99 latency anomaly detected for /v1/stream (us-east-1, gpu-pool-3) starting 2026-03-18T02:10:10Z :rotating_light:
Olivia: seeing ~2.4x p99 vs baseline, throughput OK but tails spiking. samples show spikes concentrated on longer sequences. :eyes:
Max: any obvious deploys around that time?
Olivia: small rollout ~02:05 that adjusted the continuous-batcher heuristics (weighting tweak).
Kai: hmm. I pushed a heuristic change last deploy to favour larger microbatches for short tails. could that bias estimation for mixed-length workloads? :thinking_face:
Jordan: also noticed KV cache miss rate up for that pool since ~02:08. eviction rate doubled in telemetry. might be interacting.
Olivia: grabbed a quick pprof sample from an affected replica (10s sampling):
```
gpu_kernel_dispatch            48.2%  (hot)
fused_attention               30.1%
cudaMemcpyAsync               11.9%
scheduler_enqueue_wait         5.3%
kv_cache_lookup_miss           3.8%
other                          0.7%
```
Max: dispatch dominated by small-kernel overhead + memcpy. that's a classic noisy-core pattern: lots of tiny kernels -> high dispatch overhead.
Kai: that matches a kernel selector regression I saw in the PR notes — fallback to per-layer fused kernels disabled for certain seq-len buckets. If fused kernels were skipped, we get many tiny launches.
Jordan: combined with higher KV misses, we may be thrashing between kernels and memory copies. tail latency amplifies.
Olivia: can we validate by forcing the old kernel selector on one canary pool?
Kai: yes, I can flip kernel_selector_mode=legacy on pool-3 canary. also propose lowering batch_timeout_ms from 6ms -> 3ms for the trial to reduce microbatch coalescing of heterogeneous seq lengths.
Max: and increase kv_cache_capacity by 20% for canary to see if miss rate drops.
Olivia: running commands: `infractl apply --pool gpu-pool-3 --set kernel_selector=legacy --set batch_timeout_ms=3 --set kv_cache_capacity=1.2x --target canary`
Kai: done, canary rolled at 02:25. sending profiler sampling now.
Olivia: canary pprof 10s:
```
gpu_kernel_dispatch            22.9%
fused_attention               55.4%
cudaMemcpyAsync                9.3%
scheduler_enqueue_wait         4.0%
kv_cache_lookup_miss           1.2%
```
Olivia: big change — fused kernels back up, dispatch overhead down, kv misses reduced. p99 dropped to ~1.1x baseline on canary.
Jordan: good signal. root cause: selector change + batching heuristic increase created many tiny kernel launches when mixed seq lengths and a hotter cache eviction pattern.
Max: short-term revert the selector heuristic and ship reduced batch_timeout_ms cluster-wide plus kv capacity bump. prepare rollout with 10% -> 50% -> 100% steps.
Kai: I'll prepare the PR to revert selector branch and add a feature-flagged selector test. also adding a unit test that simulates mixed-length stream to prevent regression.
Olivia: I'll coordinate rollout and watch p99/kv-miss metrics.
Jordan: logging follow-up items: (1) add a sampled flamegraph metric to nightly perf job, (2) add regression alert when dispatch% > 40% for more than 5m, (3) increase kv_cache target util threshold to avoid aggressive eviction.
Max: +1 to all. thanks team. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: alert: p99 latency resolved for /v1/stream (us-east-1, gpu-pool-3) at 2026-03-18T02:47:39Z
